description: This file defines the GrainCancellationTokenSource class, which is an Orleans-specific implementation similar to CancellationTokenSource, allowing cancellation tokens to be sent between grains. It includes methods for cancellation, disposal, and properties to access the token and cancellation status.

classes.name: GrainCancellationTokenSource
classes.description: An Orleans-specific cancellation token source that can be sent between grains, providing cancellation capabilities.

methods.name: GrainCancellationTokenSource
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the underlying grain cancellation token with a new GUID.

methods.name: Token
methods.description: Property that returns the associated GrainCancellationToken.

methods.name: IsCancellationRequested
methods.description: Property indicating whether cancellation has been requested.

methods.name: Cancel
methods.description: Method to request cancellation, returning a Task.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Releases resources used by the token source.
